ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% high-intensity (white) background versus 35% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) focal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Densely distributed low-intensity circular and irregular spots (5-15 pixel diameter) across both lobes; solid low-intensity contiguous region centered at the junction with the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a wide pixel-base; estimated interior angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations along the entire trailing boundary; significant jagged profile and irregular excision on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature sweeping from the notch towards tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density circular spot distribution; distinct yellowish-tan textured pixel clusters located on the distal edge of the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions on the lower-central region of the left lobe and near the center base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe; yellowish-tan textured plaque/growth on the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'leopard-spot' pigmentation phenotype consisting of hundreds of discrete dark punctate marks on a white field.
